releaseNotes:
Partely first customer release
Android 1.5.2 (version code 18) · Windows 1.1.3

This release improves inventory save reliability and preserves the latest first-customer workflows, receipt preview alignment, and dashboard refinements.

- Adding a part and its opening stock now saves both together. If the stock transaction fails, the part, audit entry, and sync records roll back together.
- Editing part details while adding stock now saves the edited fields and stock transaction together, using the updated purchase price for the stock ledger.
- Android only confirms stock close-out and part deletion after the operation succeeds. Failed operations keep their screen open and show the error.

- Credit sales require a saved customer belonging to the active business. Historical sale identities remain visible and can be saved from the customer selector.
- Sales steps block invalid navigation and show validation beside the relevant field. Credit due dates are required consistently, including partial payments.
- Inventory and reports count part records consistently; inventory rows continue to show each part's unit quantity.
- Supplier Orders has its own Windows sidebar destination and full screen.
- Subscription entitlements refresh when the subscription screen opens, after renewal, and periodically while the app is foregrounded.
- The Partely Windows Manual is bundled and available from Help & Support on Windows and Android; Help Center guidance reflects the current workflows.
- Removed the Android online/offline popup while retaining background connectivity handling. The developer name shown in the app is CHIRA.
- Receipt previews honor centered and right-aligned lines on Windows and Android, use the shared character-width sizing, and indicate when the receipt must be scrolled to see the rest.
- The Windows dashboard shows four KPI cards in one row and no longer includes Current Inventory Value.
